title: Synthesis, radiolabeling, and biological evaluation of methyl 6-deoxy-6-[18F]fluoro-4-thio-α-D-maltotrioside as a positron emission tomography bacterial imaging agent
content:

[18F]MFTMT was internalized only by S. aureus in vitro. In vivo imaging showed that the tracer also accumulated in S. aureus, E. coli in vivo and non-infectious inflammatory tissue, and we found SGLT1 caused this non-specific accumulation.
